description: Accounts in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yūsuf. Many familiar names on the list. Mentions ʿIwāḍ; Ibn Samḥūn; Abū l-Surūr; Dāʾūd; Abū l-Barakāt; Zikrī; the price of a Fayyūmī covering (kisā); "his brother-in-law"; Ibn al-Ṣābūnī; al-Tāhertī; Ibn Būbū(?); Dāʾūd al-Fāsī and Nissim; the debts owed to Abū Naṣr from al-Ṣābūnī and al-Nafūsī. (Information in part from Goitein’s index card)
description_he: חשבונות, כנראה בכתב יד ערוס בן יוסף; שמות מוכרים רבים
